acs.text_first_line: The OCR engine capacity and its queue are provisioned
The worker pool for the 15-minute Schedule is provisioned and scales to zero
The intake and text containers exist, with the text path and its sizing
The topic, its retry and dead-letter topics and its ACLs are confirmed
The secrets and the managed identity are provisioned and rotate
The route to the OCR provider is private and allow-listed
